name: min_max_first_last_grouped
query: SELECT account, min(payee) AS min_payee, max(payee) AS max_payee, first(date) AS first_date, last(date) AS last_date, first(number) AS first_amount, last(number) AS last_amount, min(number) AS min_amount, max(number) AS max_amount WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:Food' GROUP BY account ORDER BY account
notes: min/max over str and decimal; first/last follow the row iteration order (by date, then source order).
